tagline.zh: Microsoft Fluent 的不透明动态材质:仅采样桌面壁纸一次,绘制长驻窗口背景——与逐元素实时透出的 Acrylic 相对;Mica Alt 是强着色变体。
tagline.en: Microsoft Fluent's opaque dynamic material: samples the desktop wallpaper once to paint a long-lived window background — the counterpart to element-by-element live Acrylic; Mica Alt is the strongly-tinted variant.

origin.zh: Microsoft Learn 官方文档:Mica 是不透明动态材质,仅采样桌面壁纸一次绘制长驻窗口背景(性能导向);Mica Alt 为强着色变体,适合 tab 式标题栏;Windows App SDK 1.1+(调研 02 §3 C2)。
origin.en: Microsoft Learn's official docs: Mica is an opaque dynamic material that samples the desktop wallpaper once to paint a long-lived window background (performance-driven); Mica Alt is the strongly-tinted variant suited to tabbed title bars; Windows App SDK 1.1+ (research 02 §3 C2).

effect.zh: 官方两变体(调研 02 §3 C2):mica 壁纸取样后调淡做长驻窗口背景;mica-alt 强着色变体,适合 tab 式标题栏等需要更强应用标识的场景。demo 订阅后切换 data-variant,alt 叠加强着色薄层。
effect.en: The two official variants (research 02 §3 C2): mica derives a softened wallpaper sample as the long-lived window background; mica-alt is the strongly-tinted variant for tabbed title bars and scenes needing a stronger app identity. The demo subscribes and toggles data-variant; alt stacks a stronger tint veil.

effect.zh: 取样壁纸层之上的着色薄层强度。官方未公布数值默认(调研 02 §3 C2 仅记载材质定义与 Mica Alt 变体)——默认 50% 为社区常见值(未证实):调大应用标识越强、壁纸感越弱;调小越接近裸取样。
effect.en: Strength of the tint veil above the wallpaper-sampled layer. No official default is published (research 02 §3 C2 records the material definition and the Mica Alt variant only) — the default 50% is a community-common value (unverified): raising it strengthens app identity and weakens the wallpaper; lowering it approaches the bare sample.

note.zh: 真身仅 Windows:Windows App SDK 1.1+ / WinUI(调研 02 §3 C2)。Web 近似为纯 CSS(壁纸副本 + 滤镜 + 着色层),无需 backdrop-filter,因此不受 backdrop-filter 兼容性约束(Chrome 76 / Firefox 103 / Safari 9 亦非必需)。
note.en: The native material is Windows-only: Windows App SDK 1.1+ / WinUI (research 02 §3 C2). The web approximation is pure CSS (a wallpaper copy + filters + tint veil) and needs no backdrop-filter, so it is unconstrained by backdrop-filter compatibility (Chrome 76 / Firefox 103 / Safari 9 not even required).

fallback.zh: Web 近似不依赖 backdrop-filter,无兼容性回退需求;真身不可用时(非 Windows App SDK 环境)直接以静态壁纸取样色/中性灰做窗口背景——Mica 本身就是不透明材质,回退到实色不损失可读性。
fallback.en: The web approximation needs no backdrop-filter and thus no compatibility fallback; off Windows App SDK environments, fall back to a static wallpaper-derived fill or neutral gray — Mica is opaque by design, so a solid fallback loses no readability.

use.zh: 长驻主窗口背景:应用框架、设置页、文档工作区(官方场景)
use.en: Long-lived main-window backgrounds: app frames, settings pages, document workspaces (the official scene)

use.zh: tab 式标题栏等需要强应用标识的场景(mica-alt 官方适用)
use.en: Tabbed title bars and scenes needing strong app identity (the official mica-alt use)

use.zh: 性能敏感的大面积表面——单次采样比逐元素实时透出便宜得多
use.en: Large performance-sensitive surfaces — one sample is far cheaper than element-by-element live transparency

avoid.zh: transient UI(菜单、弹出层)——官方为这类场景保留的是 Acrylic(调研 02 §3 C1/C2)
avoid.en: Transient UI (menus, popovers) — Acrylic is the official material for those (research 02 §3 C1/C2)

avoid.zh: 需要内容透出窗口的浮层——Mica 不透明,做不到逐元素透视
avoid.en: Overlays that must transmit window content — Mica is opaque and cannot do per-element see-through

avoid.zh: 把 Web 近似的 tint 数值当官方默认——调研未记载官方数值
avoid.en: Treating the web tint numbers as official defaults — the research records no official figures

a11y.zh: Mica 是不透明材质,文字直接落在『取样壁纸 + 着色层』上:按壁纸最亮/最暗区域核对 4.5:1(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3,调研 06 §五 §17);mica-alt 强着色会整体改变表面色,深浅两套前景色都要重核。
a11y.en: Mica is opaque, so text sits directly on the 'wallpaper sample + tint veil': check 4.5:1 against the wallpaper's brightest/darkest regions (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3, research 06 §V §17); mica-alt's strong tint shifts the whole surface — re-check both light and dark foregrounds.

goal.zh: 复刻一个 Mica 主窗口:壁纸副本经重度模糊/降饱和后作为不透明窗口背景(单次采样、不随内容变化),叠 tint 着色层;mica/mica-alt 两变体可切,并用一块实时透视的 Acrylic 条对照两者差异。
goal.en: Recreate a Mica main window: a wallpaper copy, heavily blurred/desaturated, becomes the opaque window background (sampled once, unresponsive to content), with a tint veil above; switchable between mica and mica-alt, contrasted against a live see-through Acrylic strip.

acceptance.zh: 窗口背景是不透明的『取样层』:壁纸副本 + 重度模糊/降饱和滤镜,而非 backdrop-filter 实时透视
acceptance.en: The window background is an opaque 'sample layer': a wallpaper copy with heavy blur/desaturation filters, not live backdrop-filter see-through

acceptance.zh: variant 切换 mica/mica-alt,快照默认 mica;alt 叠加强着色薄层
acceptance.en: variant toggles mica/mica-alt with the snapshot default mica; alt stacks the strong-tint veil

acceptance.zh: tint 着色层透明度严格取 tint 快照值(默认 50%),UI 注明『社区常见值,官方未公布(未证实)』
acceptance.en: The tint veil uses the exact tint snapshot value (default 50%), labeled 'community-common value, no official figure published (unverified)' in the UI

acceptance.zh: 同屏放一块 Acrylic 条(实时 backdrop-filter)演示两者差异,并配文字说明
acceptance.en: Place an Acrylic strip (live backdrop-filter) side by side to demonstrate the difference, with explanatory text

acceptance.zh: 窗口内内容动画只动 transform,prefers-reduced-motion 时停用
acceptance.en: In-window content animation touches only transform; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
